workspace.description: Absolute path of the workspace the lock belongs to, without a trailing separator. When it names another workspace, every command that reads the lock fails.

platform.description: Environment platform. lip manages server workspaces only and writes "server"; null in a lock migrated from tooth_lock.json. A lock recording another platform makes workspace operations fail.

rid.description: .NET RID of the environment; null until known.

name.description: Identity: the name of the concrete package; for a tooth.json package, the tooth path, followed by "#<label>" for a labelled variant.

explicit.description: Whether the user asked for the package (as opposed to a dependency).

chain.description: Resolution chain: the ref of every hop and the Artifact index chosen at that hop. The first ref is what `lip update` requests again.

ref.description: The ref as resolved, including a git ref (e.g. "github.com/o/r@branch:main"); the first hop may also be the file: URI of a local ZIP file requested by the user.

artifact.description: Index of the Artifact selected in the routing document at this hop; null when the hop reaches a concrete document.

commit.description: For a spec ref: the commit its archive was at (the version tag's commit, or the commit the git ref resolved to). Absent for other refs and in older locks.

archive.description: Identity of the final archive; null for packages migrated from a v3 lock.

files.description: Owned files, workspace-relative and '/'-separated; files under plugins/ are recorded in the mods/ form.

manifest.description: The package document: manifest.json, or for a tooth.json package the tooth.json in format 3 with the version installed.

url.description: Where the ZIP file was read from: the https URL it was downloaded from, the file: URI of a local file, or null for a ZIP file nested in another archive.

path.description: The directory inside the ZIP file that is the package's archive root, when the package is a directory of it.
Path of the archive root in the repository; "" for the root.
